image_description: A weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel) captured in mid-stride running across green grass. The animal has a slender, elongated body with brown dorsal fur and white ventral fur. Its legs are extended in motion, and its tail is visible trailing behind. There is a prominent semi-transparent watermark text overlay across the center of the image.

A small, dark eye is visible on the side of the head, matching the expected morphology.
Short, rounded ears are visible atop the head, consistent with the species.

Despite being stretched out in motion, the limbs appear short relative to the extreme length of the body, consistent with weasel anatomy.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a large, semi-transparent watermark text ('Terrafoto...') overlaid on the subject. While likely intentional for copyright, in AI generation contexts, text overlays often exhibit slight warping or blending issues. Here, the text seems structurally sound but obscures the subject's texture.

The rear right paw blends slightly into the grass background. The definition of individual toes is lost, appearing somewhat 'melted' or soft compared to the sharper front paw. This is a common minor artifact in AI-generated animals in motion.
The background grass is heavily blurred (bokeh). This is likely an intended photographic effect (depth of field) rather than an AI artifact, but it reduces the overall sharpness context.
